svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Microservices on Azure Container Apps subtitle: The ingestion service queues delivery requests in Service Bus; the workflow service dispatches them to three services, each with its own data store # Top to bottom: Service Bus and the shared services sit in a row above the environment, the # services fan out below it and each data store sits under the service that owns it. direction: down # Filled triangles, as in Azure's reference diagrams; one port per edge. arrowhead: filled layout: { merge: false } legend: solid: Requests and data dashed: Service Bus messages dotted: Logs and metrics groups: sub: { type: azure:subscription, label: Workload subscription } rg: { type: azure:resource-group, label: rg-drone-delivery, in: sub } # The environment runs in a Microsoft-managed network in this reference, so no VNet is drawn. env: { type: box, label: Container Apps environment, icon: azure:container-apps-environments, in: rg } nodes: clients: { icon: azure:users, label: Client apps } bus: { icon: azure:azure-service-bus, label: Azure Service Bus, note: Delivery requests queue, in: rg } workflow: { icon: azure:container-apps-environments, label: Workflow service, note: Dispatches requests, in: env } # Listed after the workflow service so it sits on the right of the environment's first row, where # the HTTPS and enqueue lines enter clear of the environment's header. ingestion: { icon: azure:container-apps-environments, label: Ingestion service, note: External ingress, in: env } package: { icon: azure:container-apps-environments, label: Package service, in: env } scheduler: { icon: azure:container-apps-environments, label: Drone scheduler service, in: env } delivery: { icon: azure:container-apps-environments, label: Delivery service, in: env } docdb: { icon: azure:azure-documentdb, label: Azure DocumentDB, note: Packages, in: rg } cosmos: { icon: azure:azure-cosmos-db, label: Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL, note: Drone schedules, in: rg } kv: { icon: azure:key-vaults, label: Key Vault, note: Secrets via managed identity, in: rg } redis: { icon: azure:azure-managed-redis, label: Azure Managed Redis, note: Deliveries in flight, in: rg } insights: { icon: azure:application-insights, label: Application Insights, note: OpenTelemetry traces, in: rg } logs: { icon: azure:log-analytics-workspaces, label: Log Analytics workspace, note: Azure Monitor, in: rg } acr: { icon: azure:container-registries, label: Container Registry, note: Images reused from AKS, in: rg } edges: - clients -> ingestion: HTTPS # Written from Service Bus so the queue sits before the environment, as in Microsoft's diagram; # the arrowhead stays on the queue, because the ingestion service sends. - { from: bus, to: ingestion, arrow: start, line: dashed, label: enqueue } - bus --> workflow: receive # The other services keep their HTTP APIs and are reached by internal ingress. - workflow -> package, scheduler, delivery - package -> docdb: MongoDB API - scheduler -> cosmos: NoSQL API - delivery -> redis: cache # Only these two services read Key Vault, with user-assigned managed identities. - scheduler, delivery -> kv: secrets # Laid out from the monitors and the registry (arrowheads on them) so they sit beside Service Bus. - { from: [insights, logs], to: env, arrow: start, line: dotted } - { from: acr, to: env, arrow: start, label: pull images }

svg.title: Microservices on Azure Container Apps
svg.desc: Microservices on Azure Container Apps. 14 components in 3 groups. Connections: Client apps to Ingestion service (HTTPS); Azure Service Bus to Ingestion service (enqueue); Azure Service Bus to Workflow service (receive); Workflow service to Package service; Workflow service to Drone scheduler service; Workflow service to Delivery service; Package service to Azure DocumentDB (MongoDB API); Drone scheduler service to Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL (NoSQL API); Delivery service to Azure Managed Redis (cache); Drone scheduler service to Key Vault (secrets); Delivery service to Key Vault (secrets); Application Insights to Container Apps environment; Log Analytics workspace to Container Apps environment; Container Registry to Container Apps environment (pull images).

text.tspan: The ingestion service queues delivery requests in Service Bus; the workflow service dispatches them to three services, each with its own data store
